title: Implement an LRU cache with TTL
prompt: I need the LRUCache class in lru.py implemented. The full spec is in the module docstring at the top of lru.py: capacity and LRU eviction order, get/peek/put/delete/keys/resize, `len()` and `in`, and optional per-item expiry (ttl) driven by an injectable clock so it can be tested without sleeping. Please follow the spec exactly, including the edge cases it spells out; standard library only. Keep the class and method names as they are.
